The workflow is valid. Here is the final answer:

workflow_id: wf_gaia_010
steps:
  - id: fetch_source_data
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "{{research_topic_url}}"
      method: GET
      query:
        topic: "{{request.topic}}"
    output: source_data

  - id: validate_source_data
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{source_data}}"
      schema: research_source_schema
    output: validated_data

  - id: transform_to_report
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{validated_data}}"
      mapping:
        title: "{{validated_data.title}}"
        summary: "{{validated_data.summary}}"
        findings: "{{validated_data.findings}}"
        format: research_report
    output: research_report

  - id: authenticate_service
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      identity: research_service
      method: service_account
    output: auth_token

  - id: store_report
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: research_reports
      data: "{{research_report}}"
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    output: stored_report

  - id: notify_requester
    op: notify_user
    params:
      recipient: "{{request.requester}}"
      subject: "Research report ready"
      message: "Your research report on '{{request.topic}}' is ready. Report ID: {{stored_report.id}}"
